label: Rematch — the ninth refused crossing
location: The Drowned Vault, the ferry landing

recentEvents.value: The Continuance set him back on his route; the fares now ask why the boats run earlier when the gate-light glows.
He has washed this man to the door nine times. The tenth ride is also free.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A standing wave that keeps returning to his route, refusing rescue and calling it war.

temporaryObjective.value: Offer the crossing again. The schedule is the one argument he never stops making.
